title: GPU grain field on float ping-pong state
summary: Per-grain state in a float ping-pong pair (displacement RG, velocity BA, in px), storage chosen by `checkFramebufferStatus` from RGBA32F → RGBA16F → RGBA8 (16-bit packed displacement, no inertia); a capsule brush from the last to the current pointer position with `1 − r³` falloff, delta clamped to `24 px` a frame plus a per-grain hash scatter; a protect mask drawn from the copy block's rect zeroes the force; one points program draws the generated under-layer at moved grains' homes, then the grains at home + displacement; reset glides home (`× .88` a frame, `1.6 s`) then clears; loop leaves the ticker when at rest; reveal in place without flying grains under reduced motion, surface drawn once in the static tier
variants: Grains over a generated surface, under-layer reveal (this)
Storage forced down the chain: ?format=half or ?format=byte
Photograph field: swap surfaceImage() for a cover-cropped image texture
Terrain: add a height map's slope to the velocity before damping
